vast.audience: Government and private astronauts, payload researchers, institutional and commercial partners
vast.about: Vast develops commercial space stations and related space infrastructure. Its website connects the Haven station program, satellite and lunar initiatives, and mission opportunities with tangible engineering evidence.
breakdown: Layout & composition

The homepage opens with an immersive mission statement and video, then moves into a product showcase and a compact specification grid. The hierarchy alternates emotional scale and technical precision.
Use a single commanding visual to establish positioning, followed immediately by useful product facts.
Visual identity
Full-bleed hardware imagery, restrained warm neutrals and oversized type make engineering the visual identity rather than relying on decorative graphics.
Use actual machines, facilities and materials as brand assets.
Typography
Owners is declared for headings, Owners Text for body and navigation, and Phonic for specifications. Large display type is contrasted with small technical labels.
Separate expressive headlines from structured technical data; ensure small labels remain readable.
Interaction & navigation
The live site provides a Stations menu, product links, a video entry and an interior/exterior exploration experience on Haven-1.
Use progressive exploration for complex hardware, without making basic information dependent on motion.
Trust & credibility
Hardware integration updates, test documentation, technical specifications and mission partnership information provide concrete evidence of progress.
Show real manufacturing milestones and attributable proof rather than generic claims.
Conversion strategy
Create your mission links to a dedicated page with government, private astronaut and payload mission options, followed by an email inquiry.
Match conversion routes to buyer objectives; explain the offer before requesting contact.
vast.fit: Advanced manufacturing, robotics, aerospace, precision equipment and engineering firms with visually compelling products and a complex buying process.

fictiv.about: Fictiv connects engineering and procurement teams to managed global manufacturing capacity through a digital sourcing platform. Its offer spans CNC machining, injection molding, additive manufacturing and other custom-part processes.
breakdown: Layout & composition
The hero leads with a sourcing proposition and a compact list of benefits. A capability grid immediately translates that promise into manufacturing choices.
Place the purchasing task and concrete capabilities ahead of abstract company messaging.
Visual identity
Teal is used on the headline and instant quote CTA; dark and neutral text organize longer service information.
Reserve the strongest accent for actions and important information.
Typography
The declared Museo family uses 700, 500 and 300 variants across headlines, paragraphs and navigation.
Build a small, consistent hierarchy rather than introducing unrelated typefaces.
Interaction & navigation
Capabilities, solutions, industries and resources form distinct navigation paths. The platform offers quantity comparison and design-for-manufacturing feedback.
Let buyers enter through process, application or purchasing need.
Trust & credibility
The homepage uses network statistics, quality management information, customer testimonials and manufacturing support details. Numbers are company-reported.
Attach sourcing claims to traceability, quality controls and attributable customer evidence.
Conversion strategy
Instant quote, free pricing and team consultation are prominent, with account signup as a digital entry route.
Offer both a self-service quote and a human consultation for complex projects.
structure: Case studies and final quote CTA
fictiv.fit: Custom manufacturing, CNC machining, injection molding and sourcing businesses.

figure-robotics.about: Figure develops general-purpose humanoid robots and Helix AI. The current homepage introduces Figure 03 through home-use demonstrations and connects product capabilities to the intelligence behind them.
figure-robotics.audience: Potential users, research and commercial stakeholders; hiring and news audiences
breakdown: Layout & composition
The homepage uses successive product, intelligence, use-case and team narratives instead of a dense product catalogue.
Break a complex product story into a few clear stages.
Visual identity
White display type over motion-oriented product presentation gives the hardware prominence.
Use actual product demonstrations as the central visual asset.
Typography
PP Neue Machina Plain is declared for headings; Neue Haas Grotesk Text for explanatory copy.
Pair a distinctive display face with a practical text face.
Interaction & navigation
The navigation separates Figure 03, Helix, Index, News, Careers and Company; a full-video entry supports deeper exploration.
Give visitors independent paths into product and technical intelligence.
Trust & credibility
Product behavior and team experience are the main visible proof on the reviewed homepage.
Show real use cases and explain how the technology supports them.
Conversion strategy
The homepage leads to product and Helix exploration, with news signup and contact rather than an instant RFQ.
Choose conversion goals appropriate to product maturity and customer readiness.
figure-robotics.fit: Robotics, industrial hardware and technology brands that need to make emerging products understandable.

lumafield.about: Lumafield combines industrial X-ray CT inspection hardware, scan-analysis software and manufacturing AI to help engineering and quality teams detect defects and improve production.
lumafield.audience: Quality, manufacturing, engineering and operations teams
breakdown: Layout & composition
The opening frames a quality risk, followed by customer results, platform explanation, product families and industry applications.
Lead with the business outcome, then explain the supporting system.
Visual identity
The reviewed interface uses white text and graduated neutral tones to separate content and active states.
Make technical evidence and product views the primary visual focus.
Typography
Monument Grotesk is declared consistently across headings, navigation and copy.
A coherent type family can support both a technical catalogue and editorial storytelling.
Interaction & navigation
Numbered platform capability tabs reveal distinct functions. Navigation separates platform, solutions, resources and company.
Use progressive disclosure to explain complex systems without burying the overview.
Trust & credibility
The homepage presents customer-program metrics, a named casting defect case and an attributed customer quotation.
Show baseline, intervention and measurable outcome together; identify company-reported figures.
Conversion strategy
Contact Sales and Launch Voyager are distinct paths, supporting sales conversations and existing software access.
Separate new-buyer actions from product access and make the contact objective explicit.
lumafield.fit: Industrial inspection, metrology, factory software and technically complex enterprise products.

skydio.about: Skydio offers autonomous drone hardware, mission-management software and related services for enterprise and public-sector operations.
skydio.audience: Inspection, mapping, infrastructure and public-sector teams
breakdown: Layout & composition
The reviewed homepage presents a featured drone, application families, hardware models, software and customer stories.
Organize complex product portfolios by both application and product family.
Visual identity
The archived editorial notes emphasize product imagery and application photography; the live navigation uses restrained dark and gray text.
Keep technical products recognizable while showing their practical context.
Typography
Case is declared throughout the reviewed navigation and body elements.
Use consistent typography to unify a broad product ecosystem.
Interaction & navigation
An extensive menu groups product hardware, software, applications, industries and resources. Contact is segmented by team.
Provide clear task-based paths without requiring visitors to know product names.
Trust & credibility
Named customer stories, platform support and security information establish credibility.
Pair product claims with attributable deployment outcomes.
Conversion strategy
The homepage routes users into featured product exploration and a contact selector for sales, partnerships or support.
Direct each inquiry to the appropriate team instead of a generic contact destination.
skydio.fit: Industrial equipment portfolios, inspection tools and enterprise hardware-plus-software vendors.
